rows.speaker: أبو سفيان
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas transmits Abu Sufyan’s account of Heraclius testing Muhammad’s claim and judging the signs prophetic; the Prophet’s letter invites him to Islam and quotes 3:64’s shared call to worship God alone; Abu Sufyan later accepted Islam.

none: Umar’s report concerns the Prophet’s temporary separation from his wives and cites 66:4–5 and 4:83; it does not address 6:128.

words: ٱلنَّارُ مَثْوَىٰكُمْ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ
rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: Abu Hurayra reports the Prophet’s Judgment narrative: idolaters follow what they worshipped, while monotheists cross the bridge and some sinners are drawn from Hell by mercy; the last man eventually enters Paradise.
rows.anchor: أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ نَاسًا قَالُوا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ

words: ٱلنَّارُ مَثْوَىٰكُمْ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ
rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: Anas reports the Prophet describing the resurrection’s appeal for relief and his repeated intercession bringing groups from the Fire to Paradise, until only those for whom eternal residence is established remain.
rows.anchor: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ

words: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ
rows.speaker: قتادة
rows.claim: In Ibn Ubayd’s transmission, Qatada glosses those whom the Qur’an holds back from exiting Hell as people for whom eternal residence has become obligatory.
rows.anchor: قَالَ قَتَادَةُ أَىْ وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ الْخُلُودُ

words: ٱلنَّارُ مَثْوَىٰكُمْ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ
rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: Abu Hurayra reports the Prophet reserving his one granted supplication as intercession for his community on Judgment Day, offering eschatological context for the verse’s exception in describing enduring punishment.
rows.anchor: أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم

words: ٱلنَّارُ مَثْوَىٰكُمْ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ
rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: Abu Hurayra tells Kaʿb al-Aḥbar that the Prophet reserved his one granted supplication as intercession for the community on Judgment Day; when Kaʿb asks whether he heard it directly, Abu Hurayra confirms.
rows.anchor: أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ لِكَعْبِ الأَحْبَارِ إِنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ
